name: Amorepacific Corporation
summary: Amorepacific Corporation researches, develops, manufactures, markets, sells, and trades cosmetics and beauty products worldwide. It offers cosmetics under the Sulwhasoo, Laneige, Innisfree, AP Beauty, Hera, Primera, Iope, Mamonde, Hanyul, espoir, Etude, Odyssey, Be Ready, Holitual, Tata Harper, and Cosrx brands; medical beauty products under the Aestura brand; beauty devices under the maekON brand; and inner beauty products under the VitalBeautie brand.
